landing.heroDesc: The most fun, effective, and free way to learn Thai. Speak from day one, practice writing, and master the alphabet step by step.
landing.methodDesc: Never get bored with a multitude of exercises designed to improve every aspect of your Thai learning.
landing.pairMatchDesc: Learn vocabulary by matching Thai words to their translation. With or without audio, with or without text. Challenge yourself to build your memory.
landing.sentenceDesc: Don't limit yourself to vocabulary. Quickly learn to produce your own sentences by assembling words in the right order.
landing.audioDesc: Thai is a tonal language. Train your ear with our 100% audio listening exercises, and choose the right answer from multiple options.
landing.writeDesc: Practice spelling by assembling the right consonants and vowels to form complete Thai words. Smart help is available if you get stuck.
landing.consTip: 💡 Consonant 'h' (Ho Nam). Here, it will be silent and change the tone of the following consonant.
landing.discussDesc: Listen to real conversations and practice answering them by picking the right response according to context.
landing.alphaDesc: Memorize consonants and vowels with simple and fun mnemonic devices.
landing.metricsDesc: Carefully selected vocabulary designed to help you reach the necessary level to travel in Thailand with confidence.
landing.featDesc: Our interactive method focuses on what you need to communicate quickly.
landing.f1Desc: Match, complete and build short sentences interactively to retain vocabulary effortlessly.
landing.f2Desc: Every word has pronunciation in phonetic format and high-quality audio with the right accents.
landing.f3Desc: Learn to spell your first words by visually selecting the appropriate consonants and vowels.
landing.detectiveDesc: Find hidden objects in Thai scenes to learn vocabulary in a visual context and earn XP.
landing.pronunciationDesc: Practice speaking with our speech recognition tool. Perfect your Thai accent and tones.
landing.rankDesc: Earn XP every day, complete your lessons, and compare your progress with the community.
landing.ctaDesc: Join us and start Unit 1. Jump right in, no registration required to begin!
landing.footer: © 2026 ThaiLearn. Learning Thai has never been easier.
